description: Land Acquisition - Kataragama, Kataragama D/S Division, Monaragala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels for road broadening, including lot numbers, land names, claimants, encroachers, and land extents. This fits perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related administrative matters.
